title: TheLithium.Imprint project configuration
description: Optional snapshots.config.json in the test-project root. Every property has a default, so the file is only needed to change one.

update.description: What a successful test is allowed to write. verify: never write. missing: create absent snapshots, fail on changes. all: create and overwrite, and delete snapshots the test no longer captures.

allowEmptyTests.description: Allow a test that captures nothing to pass instead of failing as a likely mistake.

files.description: Where snapshots and failure artifacts are written.

snapshotFolderName.description: Folder name that holds the snapshots, created next to the test sources.

snapshotRootPath.description: Put snapshots somewhere else entirely. Project-relative or absolute. Replaces the default source-adjacent root.

failureArtifactPath.description: Where expected/received files are written when a test fails. Must be outside the snapshots root.

naming.description: How snapshot folders and files get their names.

unnamedCaptures.description: Filename for a capture with no explicit name. name-then-order: use the variable name, else snapshot-1, snapshot-2. order: always snapshot-1, snapshot-2. explicit-only: require a name at every call.

useFrameworkDisplayNames.description: Name the test folder after the framework display name (e.g. [Fact(DisplayName = "...")]) instead of the C# method name, when one exists.

comparison.description: When a stored snapshot and a new capture count as equal. These rules never change what is written to disk.

numericTolerance.description: Largest absolute difference accepted between two JSON numbers. 0 means exact.

ignoreArrayOrder.description: Match JSON array elements in any order. Duplicates still have to appear the same number of times.

ignoreStringCase.description: Compare string values case-insensitively. Property names stay case-sensitive.

ignoreLineEndings.description: Treat CRLF and LF as equal in text snapshots. Keep this on for cross-platform repositories.

ignoreTrailingWhitespace.description: Ignore spaces and tabs at the end of each line of a text snapshot.

maxUnorderedArrayLength.description: Longest array ignoreArrayOrder will try to match. Bounds the matching cost.

limits.description: Safety valves. Raise one only when a legitimate snapshot hits it.

maxNestingDepth.description: Deepest object or array nesting that will be serialized.

maxValuesPerSnapshot.description: Most values a single capture may visit. Catches runaway or cyclic graphs.

maxBytesPerSnapshot.description: Largest single snapshot file, in UTF-8 bytes.

lockTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for another process to release the snapshot folder lock.
